language_contract: Caller declares en. Missing/unsupported declaration rejects; no reliable automatic language detection is claimed. Misdeclared and mixed-language text may evade recognition.
installation: PV-13 locks transitive dependencies and artifact hashes, verifies model compatibility on supported Python platforms, and refuses missing/incompatible artifacts; no runtime downloads or unlisted recognizers.

presets.balanced-v1: Use balanced action in every category. Strict schema off. Mandatory rules always on.
presets.strict-v1: Use strict action in every category plus closed structured memory fields with declared typed validators.
presets.custom-v1: Explicit per-category supported actions layered on balanced-v1; mandatory block cannot change.

limit_semantics: Per operation, aggregate body, metadata keys/values, display names and generated output. Oversize/depth, timeout or detector error rejects before content side effects. No prefix truncation. A batch fails atomically before enqueue if any item fails. These are explicit v1 contract bounds, not performance evidence.
overlap_semantics: Any block rejects entire input. Merge overlapping redact spans to their union. Redact wins over pseudonymize. Different-category overlapping pseudonym spans reject as ambiguous; identical same-category spans deduplicate. Nonoverlapping replacements apply from right to left with original offsets. An allow never cancels another applicable rule.
error_semantics: Fail the whole admission/query/output before provider, embedding, durable write or content logging; return fixed reason code only, never offending values.
redaction: Replace detected span with category-specific [CATEGORY_REMOVED]; reject a claim/input if preserved source qualifiers or participant relationships become ambiguous. Do not retain matched spans in reports.

pseudonyms.input_encoding: Length-prefixed UTF-8 category and exact detected value, with domain prme-pseudonym-v1; no case-fold identity merging.
pseudonyms.source_spoofing: Escape all source occurrences of the reserved [PRME_PSEUDONYM_V1: prefix to literal inert text before scanning. Generated outputs may use only source-issued tokens in the same boundary.
pseudonyms.key_loss: Refuse continuity under the old epoch. Explicit new epoch creates new tokens; never silently merge identities.
pseudonyms.erasure: Tokens and all derivatives remain in the copy inventory; keys live in purpose-separated external provider state. Fact erasure still required.

custom_rules.matching: Literals use exact case-sensitive Unicode scalar matching, maximum lengths above; no arbitrary regex or callable. typed_identifier selects only a listed built-in category recognizer. A literal topic block rejects the whole input.
custom_rules.config_protection: Custom literals may themselves be sensitive; encrypt policy rule material, exclude from routine policy inspection/logs and bind its opaque version. Never use removed text as a public rule ID.

strict_schema.rules: Deployment supplies a versioned immutable field-name/validator schema. Field names are non-content ASCII identifiers, enum values pass the same sanitizer, all strings require opaque ID/pseudonym/timestamp/finite enum validators. No arbitrary notes/free text. Required conditions, negation and attribution must fit the schema or admission rejects. Do not guess a missing qualifier.

known_unsupported: Other languages, unreliable or false en declarations and mixed-language semantic coverage
Base64/hex encoded secrets, arbitrary homoglyphs, images and binary attachments
Secret types not matching a listed credential grammar, indirect hints and contextual confidential facts
US identifiers other than SSN; international identifiers not explicitly listed
Reversible pseudonym lookup, global cross-project identity and automatic semantic topic classification
metrics_contract: PV-13/PV-11 publish per-category labeled true/false positives/negatives and benign-damage counts. Unsupported examples are reported separately, never counted as true negatives or omitted to inflate recall.

recognizers.scope: ASCII case-insensitive whole keys password, passwd, pwd, api_key, access_token, client_secret; 0-8 spaces/tabs then : or = then 0-8 spaces/tabs and an optional single/double quote, followed by 1-4096 non-whitespace non-quote characters. Presence of this supported assignment blocks the whole input.

Exact -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----, -----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----, -----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----, -----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY----- or -----BEGIN ENCRYPTED PRIVATE KEY----- header blocks, even if the key body is incomplete.
ASCII case-insensitive whole Bearer followed by 1-8 spaces/tabs and 8-4096 ASCII letters/digits or . _ ~ + / - with 0-2 trailing = characters. No network validation.
Whole ghp_ followed by exactly 36 ASCII alphanumeric characters. This fixture grammar does not claim support for every GitHub credential format.
Upstream EMAIL_ADDRESS; ASCII/international email formats are supported only as recognized by the pinned implementation.
PHONE_NUMBER with supported_regions=[US,GB], leniency=1; no implicit additional country registry.
PERSON only from en_core_web_sm; named English persons are heuristic, no identity resolution.
LOCATION only using the pinned spaCy entity mapping; not a promise to detect every street address.
US_SSN only; upstream validation/context rules apply.
CREDIT_CARD with upstream checksum/format validation; not bank account detection.
IP_ADDRESS with upstream IPv4/IPv6 validation; not hostnames or location inference.

ASCII email local part 1-64 letters/digits or . _ % + -, then optional 0-1 spaces around [at] or (at), domain labels 1-63 letters/digits/hyphen separated by [dot] or (dot) with optional 0-1 spaces, final suffix 2-24 ASCII letters. Match spans cover the full original form, not just the projected @/. version; reject invalid offset mappings. Other obfuscation unsupported.
Exact configured literals, no automatic guessing. Overlap/action rules apply.
Exact configured topic literals, not semantic inference; block affects entire input.

categories.activation: only when explicit literals are configured
only when explicit literals are configured

context_enhancement: Disabled. Ignore all unlisted NLP labels; use exact per-recognizer thresholds, not upstream dynamic registry defaults.
